For Grade 1 learners who benefit significantly from visual scaffolds, the visual representation could be more prominent. While the requirement is technically met through the presence of picture-based problems, the proportional balance favors text-based presentation substantially.

Problems include single-digit cases (1-1, 3-1, 4-0), ten-based cases (10-2, 10-3, 10-10), and multi-digit cases up to 18-9.
